column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - reviewed helpers the DREAMCAST build inlined at every call.
# A helper inlined at all of its call sites emits no procedure of its own, so
# it never reaches the CodeView roster. Its absence there is therefore the
# EXPECTED shape, not a missing counterpart, and win_only.tsv is the wrong
# list: these are not Complete-only definitions. Each row must cite the
# caller-side residue that witnesses the inlining - an inlined body leaves
# lexical scopes and its by-value parameters behind in the caller, which is
# what `homm3 dreamcast show <caller>` reports as "Lexical scopes" and
# "Locals". A row with no such witness does not belong here.
# Stale rows fail the build, same as win_only.tsv.
